gate.dispatchTitle: {count, plural, one {# dispatch awaiting approval} other {# dispatches awaiting approval}}
gate.disbursementTitle: {count, plural, one {# release awaiting approval} other {# releases awaiting approval}}

degraded.title: Some data is unavailable
degraded.agentExplanation: The agent service is not reachable. Incidents below are ordered by the deterministic score, not by a model. Nothing here is an assisted ranking.
degraded.backendExplanation: Showing the last picture received. It is {age} old and may not reflect the current situation.
degraded.reasoningExplanation: This plan carries no agent reasoning thread, so the factor breakdown and the unservable list cannot be shown. Decide from the incidents and the route below, or reject and ask for a re-plan.
degraded.listUnavailable: This queue cannot be listed yet
degraded.listExplanation: The ledger service has no endpoint that lists entitlements awaiting release, so this page cannot show you what is waiting. It is not empty because nothing is waiting — it is empty because nothing can ask. Open a release by its entitlement reference below.

cop.title: Common operating picture
cop.queueEmpty: No incidents in the current filter
cop.queueEmptyHint: The filter may be excluding them. Clear it to see the whole queue.
cop.contextEmptyHint: Choose a row in the queue to see its reports, its triage factors and its audit trail.
cop.unplaceable: {count, plural, one {# incident has no coordinate and is not on the map} other {# incidents have no coordinate and are not on the map}}
cop.layersNotBuilt: Division boundaries, report density and delivery gaps are specified but not built. They are absent rather than shown as empty layers.
cop.noFactors: No factor breakdown was recorded for this incident.
cop.auditEmpty: Nothing has been recorded against this incident yet.
cop.auditUnavailable: The audit trail could not be read. This is not an empty history.

dispatch.title: Dispatch approval
dispatch.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting for a dispatch decision
dispatch.queueEmptyHint: Plans appear here when the triage agent proposes one. Nothing is hidden by a filter.
dispatch.routeUnavailable: No route geometry on this plan
dispatch.factors: Why these incidents are ranked here
dispatch.unservable: Incidents this plan does not cover
dispatch.unservableNone: Every incident in scope is covered by this plan.
dispatch.unservableWarning: These incidents were considered and left out. Read them before approving.
dispatch.totpHint: Six digits from your authenticator app. Required to approve.
dispatch.totpIncomplete: Enter all six digits to approve.
dispatch.approveConfirm: This sends responders towards a hazard. There is no undo.
dispatch.planNotFoundHint: It may have been decided already. Return to the queue to see its status.

disbursement.title: Release approval
disbursement.queueEmpty: Nothing is waiting for a release decision
disbursement.queueEmptyHint: Entitlements appear here once they carry every required approval.
disbursement.householdRefOnly: Reference only. The approver does not need the name and does not get it.
disbursement.evidenceNone: No photographs attached to this assessment
disbursement.grievanceOpen: An open grievance blocks this release
disbursement.grievanceExplanation: This entitlement has an unresolved grievance. The release endpoint will refuse it, and it should: the household has said something is wrong and nobody has answered yet.
disbursement.anomalyExplanation: A pattern in this division was flagged for review. It is not a finding and it names nobody. Read the innocent explanations before deciding.
disbursement.segregationOk: You are neither the assessor nor an approver of this entitlement.
disbursement.segregationBlocked: You cannot release this: you are recorded as {role} on it.
disbursement.releaseConfirm: This moves money. There is no undo; a mistake is corrected with a compensating entry.
disbursement.simulated: Every payment rail in this phase is a mock. References start MOCK-.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: The request did not complete. The correlation ID below identifies it in the server logs.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this
errors.forbiddenHint: Your role does not cover this area or this action.
errors.stepUpHint: This action needs a second factor from the last five minutes.

auth.totpPrompt: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.failedHint: Check the username and password and try again.
auth.emailHint: The address your account was created with.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.emptyHint: Clear the filter to see the whole list. Nothing is hidden by scope here.
incidents.locationLowHint: A point with low confidence is not trusted for dispatch. It still counts towards the division, and a responder needs a person to confirm where it is.
incidents.notFoundHint: It may have been merged into another. Return to the list.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.emptyHint: An alert is drafted from a published template. Templates are seeded as DRAFT and need a human signature in each language first.
alerts.gapsHint: Divisions with low confirmed delivery, worst first. This is where to send a vehicle with a loudhailer.
alerts.gapsNone: No division is below the delivery threshold
alerts.gapsNoneHint: Every targeted division has confirmed delivery above the threshold. That is not the same as everyone having heard it.
alerts.noDenominator: Counts are always shown with what they are a fraction of.

audit.title: Audit
audit.ledgerEmptyHint: No entries have been written yet. Nothing is filtered out of this view.
audit.anomaliesEmptyHint: Nothing has been flagged for review, or every flag has been disposed of.
audit.disposeNoteHint: Required for every outcome, including a false positive. A flag closed without reasoning tells the next reviewer nothing.
audit.neverNames: A flag is a pattern, not a finding. It names nobody.
audit.readsAreAudited: Every read on this page is itself recorded in the audit log, including this one.

review.title: Review queue
review.emptyHint: Low-confidence transcriptions and flagged reports appear here.

grievances.title: Grievances
grievances.emptyHint: A grievance is raised by a household, by SMS or through an officer.

notBuilt.title: This screen is not built yet
notBuilt.body: It is named in build file 20 and it does not exist. Nothing is hidden behind it and nothing is broken — there is simply no page here yet. The handoff lists which routes are outstanding.

compose.title: Compose an alert
compose.templateHint: Only published templates can be dispatched.
compose.noPublishedHint: All twelve seeded templates are drafts. Before an alert can be dispatched a human must sign each language and then publish it. That is the gate working, not a missing seed.
compose.awaitingSignature: awaiting a signature in Sinhala or Tamil
compose.freeTextForcesSignoff: Anything here is outside the reviewed template, so the alert goes to PENDING_SIGNOFF and a human reads it before it can be dispatched. Say what the templates cannot; just know it will wait for a person.
compose.divisionsHint: Comma separated, e.g. LK-11-03-045. Area selection on the map is not built.
compose.dryRunRequired: A dry run is required before sending
compose.dryRunExplanation: The confirm step shows the exact target count, the per-channel breakdown and the per-language split. Sending a life-safety message to an unknown number of people is not something this console will let you do.
compose.overLimitBlocks: One of the three renderings needs more than two segments. Shorten it before drafting: the language that runs long is the one whose community gets the warning last and incomplete.
compose.hazardEventHint: Which event this alert is about.
compose.noHazardEvents: No open hazard event. An alert has to name the event it is about, and one is declared by the forecast agent or by DMC — not from this console.
compose.drafted: Draft created: {reference}. It still needs sign-off and a dry run before it can be sent.

chain.title: Chain verification
chain.subtitle: Recompute the hash chain and compare it against the published daily anchors. This is where the claim that a record cannot be edited after it is written gets tested rather than read.
chain.verifyRangeHint: Leave both blank to check the whole chain. A result always names the range it covers, so a partial check is never mistaken for a whole one.
chain.diverged: Diverged — the chain does not recompute
chain.anchorsHint: One Merkle root per day, each chained to the day before, so removing a whole day is as detectable as altering one row inside it.
chain.noAnchorsHint: An anchor is written once a day has entries to anchor.
chain.noExternalAnchor: {count, plural, one {# day has no external anchor} other {# days have no external anchor}}
chain.noExternalAnchorHint: The root is computed and chained, but it has not been written to storage outside this system. Until it is, the chain is verifiable against a database the operator controls — which is a weaker claim than it looks, and the external anchor is the half that survives an operator rewriting it.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.readOnly: Read-only. Creating an assessment needs photographs, GPS and an offline queue, which is the Field Companion’s job — a form here would be a way of entering damage figures nobody stood in front of.
assessments.emptyHint: Assessments arrive from the Field Companion, or by sync when a handset regains signal.

admin.title: Administration
admin.templatesHint: A template needs a native signature in Sinhala and in Tamil before it can be published, and no alert can be dispatched from an unpublished one. This is the gate; it is not a formality.
admin.noTemplatesHint: Templates are created by seeding or through POST /templates.
admin.needsBothSignatures: Publication needs both signatures. The server refuses without them, and so does a database predicate.
admin.schedulesHint: Read-only. A schedule is what every entitlement is calculated from; changing one from a console during an incident would silently re-price work already done. Versions are added by migration.
admin.noSchedulesHint: Schedules arrive with the seed data or by migration.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Entitlements waiting for a signature. Oldest first: the household that has waited longest is the one to reach first.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for an approval
approvals.emptyHint: An entitlement appears here once an assessment has been accepted and valued.
approvals.totpHint: Six digits from your authenticator app. An approval is the signature the money gate relies on.
approvals.notARelease: Approving is not releasing. A different person confirms the money should move, and the service refuses a release by whoever approved it.
